newsitem.title: BAHRAIN: PRESS DIGEST - Saudi Arabia - Feb 23.
newsitem.headline: PRESS DIGEST - Saudi Arabia - Feb 23.

text.p: These are some of the leading stories in the Saudi Arabian press on Sunday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
- Saudi Defence Minister Prince Sultan to hold talks with U.S. officials on Gulf situation.
- A Filipino suspect held in connection with the murder of an American couple has not been charged yet, official says.
- Egyptian-Saudi Petroleum Exploration and Drilling Company signs a three-year exploration contract with Aramco.
- Agriculture and water minister signs a $117 million water project contract.
- Saudi Arabia to set up a chemical plant in the industrial city of Jubail with a capital of 352 million riyals.
